profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary:
HEADLINE
Full Stack Software Developer with Background in Education, Theoretical Mathematics, and Project and People Management

SUMMARY
Full-Stack Software Developer with 5+ years of experience building web applications for clients to help improve their business workflow and daily activities. Jack-of-all-trades with broad experience supporting organizations ranging from 10-100 employees. Proven experience providing technical support for both hardware and software issues. Proficient in a wide range of operating systems, including Linux, and Windows. 

Open-minded and a quick learner, able to pick up on new processes, systems, and technologies quickly. Team player who thrives while working collaboratively or independently. Excellent time management and multitasking skills, with previous experience managing up to 5 simultaneous projects. Known by peers for strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical resources.

SKILLS
- Javascript, HTML, CSS 
- ReactJS, AngularJS
- Strapi
- Elixir, C#, .NET, Ruby
- Microsoft Business Central AL language
- SQL Server Management Studio, SQL Server, Mysql, PostgreSQL 
- AWS, Azure, Azure DevOps
- Git, GitHub
- Teaching, coaching
- People management and project management
- QA Testing and Analysis

volunteerExperiences.role: Volunteer Teacher and Coordinator of Mentoring Program
volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteer my time teaching adults on a free, not-for-profit, educational website. I run the mentoring program where I pair mentors with students who need extra help with assignments or just the school in general. I write curriculum, teach the curriculum, and grade all assignments by hand for over 700 students.

I have been marching and instructing Winter guard and color guard for 17 years. I am the captain for Light Brigade South Senior Winter Guard based out of Richmond Virginia. I also guest instruct at clinics around the state as well as help to tech and choreograph weapon lines.
